
package dailyassignments;

class Employee
{
	int empId;
	String empName;
	double salary;
	

Employee(int empId1, String empName1, double salary1)
{
		
	this.empId = empId1;
	this.empName = empName1;
	this.salary = salary1;

	
}


void displayDetails()
{
	System.out.println(empId + " " + empName + " "+ salary);
	
}


public class ThisAndFinalKeyword {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		
		Employee obj = new Employee(100, "Priya", 100.10);
		obj.displayDetails();
		Employee obj1 = new Employee(101, "Siya", 200.10);
		obj1.displayDetails();
		
	}

}
}
